regression.report_completion: The first six answers and judge outputs were already frozen when missing historical submission receipts interrupted report generation. Original receipts were attached and the same reports completed with AI transport disabled. All reader/judge output hashes remained unchanged; no answer rerun or score selection.

final_physical_change_validation.kind: deterministic replay, not a new AI score
final_physical_change_validation.compared: All 407 product invocations replayed; three unchanged harness rejections had no product call. Product calls replayed through final assembly on independently migrated original prepared materials. Recursive equality includes original text, evidence positions, scores, ordering and graph results; only transient basis receipts, request IDs, creation/expiration and generation identities are excluded; opaque navigation tokens are normalized with presence preserved. Subsequent navigation requests are rebound to newly issued tokens and executed.
final_physical_change_validation.material_checks: Every replay material has exact original and semantic checks and bitwise vector comparison; no semantic regeneration.

tests.workload: frozen 20 documents / 20 queries, local model explicitly warmed with the original warmup query; cold first-write cost reported separately

resources.conditions: Same frozen 20-document/20-query text, local model and four-thread configuration. Windows authoritative process-tree sampler at 50 ms, measured without competing probes. Warm document workload explicitly invokes the original warmup query because the new empty-corpus search correctly skips embedding. Cold first-batch cost is retained separately; not relabeled as warm throughput.
resources.long_input_boundary_note: Before atomic schema-creation refinement, after buffers and compact postings. 8.39 MB input and full original/evidence/dual protocol outputs are exact; tree 212.31 MiB, non-model 52.74 MiB. Overlapped a diagnostic write probe: its timings are not an uncontended acceptance measurement. Final full repository tests cover the affected paths.
resources.previous_observations: verification/resource-observations; all preserved with original binary identities and conditions; prior fail/overlap/cold-model observations are not erased.

storage.synthetic_scope: 80 and 160 instances from the frozen performance content/vector generator, adding only an explicit synthetic vector-space identity required by the new store. No AI. Not a 100000-record release score.
storage.interpretation: Same real 48-asset sample: SQLite 8749056 -> 6209536 bytes, -29.03%; 22359 postings retained, zero free pages after reclaim. Originals, semantic records, vectors and canonical term/frequency hashes unchanged. 80/160 frozen fixtures: 2260992/3375104 -> 1867776/2605056 bytes. Existing encoded derived ratio remains about 1.03 <1.35; this is not the whole SQLite file ratio. Physical index/page/control overhead is reported separately. No new AI, no removal of searchable information, no full-corpus in-memory representation.

completion.quality_scope: Storage migration and cost closure only. Recorded natural-language results remain 11/14 and 24/24; this is not a claim that all information-use failures are solved or that the complete product is release-certified.

history.invalid_replay_attempt: An intermediate SQLite snapshot still carried its prior product composition; final code correctly rejects this incompatible binding. The accepted replay migrates independent original prepared materials through the formal entry point and verifies equivalence. No product guard or stored identity was bypassed.

closed_findings.U4-B1: An unknown or activated target cannot reopen legacy authority; early safe cancellation and forward recovery remain supported.
closed_findings.U4-B2: Running and restarted handoff authorization uses the current credential in bounded control selection; delegated managers work and invalid/revoked management credentials remain denied.

independent_review.measurement_scope: No retrieval or semantic-processing changes. Earlier AI scores, resource measurements and 407-call replay retain their original composition identities; this review adds affected recovery and authorization validation, not new AI scores or performance measurements.
